entities.name: Nyxia
entities.description: Nyxia chooses revenge without losing control, acting closer to an executioner than a monster.
entities.quote: Nyxia choosing revenge without losing control — why this matters Up until now, power in your universe has followed this rule: Emotion → loss of control → catastrophe

entities.name: Asetra
entities.description: A figure whose worldview cracks when Nyxia kills Alter David without losing balance.
entities.quote: Asetra Khalid Alter Ethan Even early Nyxia arcs Now you’re breaking that rule.

entities.name: Khalid
entities.description: A figure whose justification collapses after Alter David's death.
entities.quote: Asetra’s worldview cracks Khalid’s justification collapses Niharo’s logic weakens

entities.name: Alter David
entities.description: A character whose worldview involves believing restraint is weakness, emotion is leverage, and kindness is manipulation.
entities.quote: Alter David believes: restraint is weakness emotion is leverage kindness is manipulation

entities.name: Yoshiko
entities.description: A female character whose earlier death can give Nyxia's revenge clarity born from loss.
entities.quote: If Yoshiko dies earlier: Nyxia’s revenge is not rage It’s clarity born from loss

entities.name: Grace
entities.description: One of the women in the universe who survives quietly and cleans up after wars.
